notes.title: What this demo shows
notes.1: Built for tech-savvy adults (25–40) managing a newly diagnosed condition between visits. Demo: ADHD medication titration.
notes.2: Daily tab: a one-minute check-in (focus, sleep, appetite, side effects, missed doses). No AI, just fixed questions the doctor's care plan enables.
notes.3: Home: the pre-visit chat. It asks what the check-ins can't (how things feel overall, what to change) and never re-asks the profile.
notes.4: The doctor sees 'since last visit' trends, medicine side effects from the public URPL registry, and where the patient's answers differ from check-ins or device data.
notes.5: A rule-based safety net runs on every answer and note. Type "chest pain" in a check-in note to see it.
notes.tail: MVP scope: adults who use a smartphone and a wearable. Accessibility for older patients and carers is on the roadmap, not in this demo.
chat.disclose.title: You're chatting with the clinic's AI assistant.
chat.disclose.body: It asks questions and passes your answers to {doctor} before your visit on {when}. It doesn't diagnose or give medical advice.
chat.honest.title: Please answer honestly
chat.honest.body: Your answers help decide how urgently you're seen. Giving false information on purpose to get an earlier appointment is misuse of the service and can lead to consequences under the clinic's rules. Honest mistakes are never penalised. If you're not sure about something, say so.
chat.gdpr: Your answers are health data. {clinic} processes them to provide your care (GDPR Art. 9(2)(h)).
chat.demoSuggestion: Demo shortcut: tap to answer, or type your own
chat.degraded: The assistant is using the standard questionnaire right now. Your answers still reach your doctor.
voice.check: Check what we heard, edit if needed, then send.
voice.unsupported: Voice input isn't available in this browser. You can type instead.
voice.denied: Microphone access was denied. You can type instead.
voice.failed: We couldn't hear that. Try again or type instead.
sum.title: Here's what we'll send
sum.sub: Check it reads right. {doctor} only sees it after you confirm.
sum.correctPh: e.g. It started closer to 4 weeks ago
sum.truthful: My answers are true to the best of my knowledge.
sum.confirm: Confirm and send to my doctor
sent.title: Sent to {doctor}
sent.lead: Your doctor will read it before your visit on {when}.
sent.small: If things get worse before then, call the clinic. In an emergency, call 112.
em.title: Let's get you checked now
em.body: Thank you for telling us. What you described is best looked at right away, so please don't wait for your appointment.
em.free: The number is 112. It's free, and the person who answers will tell you what to do.
em.step1: Call 112 and say what you told us here.
em.step2: Stay where you are and keep your phone close.
em.step3: If someone is nearby, ask them to stay with you.
em.notSure: Not sure it's serious? Call anyway. They'll help you decide. We've also let {clinic} know, so they can follow up with you.
appt.call: Need another appointment? Call the clinic on
prof.note: {doctor} sees your profile with every visit, so the chat won't ask these questions again. Only you can change it.
prof.meds.note: Prescriptions from other doctors, plus anything you buy yourself, like painkillers or supplements. Medicines from this clinic are already on file.
prof.add.name: Medicine name
prof.doc.title: This is already part of your medical record
prof.doc.body: It was used in a visit you confirmed, so it can't be deleted. You can mark it as no longer current instead; your doctor will see the change.
prof.data.note: Everything here is optional. You can delete it at any time; your clinic's own records aren't affected.
prof.wipe.title: Delete your whole profile?
prof.wipe.body: Your lifestyle answers and medicines from elsewhere will be removed and your doctor won't see them. Entries already in your medical record are marked as no longer current.
day.audit: Audit log and AI call metadata
brief.copyBlocked: Copy blocked here. Select the text manually.
brief.legendHint: Select any record ID to open the original.
brief.patientWords: In the patient's words (copied verbatim, not AI-generated)
brief.medsNote: Reconcile with the patient: patient-reported entries are not verified by the clinic.
brief.noHistory: No clinic records connected to this complaint.
brief.noLifestyle: No relevant lifestyle data. The patient has not provided any.
brief.footer: This brief organises information only. It contains no diagnoses, risk scores or suggested actions. Every statement is checked against its source record before it is shown.
brief.transparency: AI input: {n} of {total} records relevant to this complaint, pseudonymised · written by {provider} ({prompt}) · {dropped} statements removed by validation.
brief.degraded: The AI was unavailable; the deterministic fallback produced this brief.
brief.injection: The patient's text contained instruction-like content; it is shown verbatim and was treated as data only.
drawer.verified: Citation verified: this record exists in the clinic's FHIR store.
urgent.title: Flagged by the emergency safety net
urgent.when: Flagged at {time}. The patient was told to call 112 and the chat stopped.
urgent.rules: Red-flag rules are deterministic, not AI. Intake stopped at the flag, so there is no brief for this patient.
empty.body: The brief appears once the patient confirms their summary.
empty.reminder: A reminder text goes out 24 hours before the visit.
bg.title: Break-glass access
bg.note: For substitutions and emergencies. Requires a reason, lasts 8 hours and is audited.
bg.reasonPh: e.g. Covering for Dr. Mazur, patient called in
bg.reasonShort: Please give a reason of at least 10 characters.
audit.llmNote: Metadata only: task, provider, prompt version, latency, tokens and validation result. Prompts and responses are never logged.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.note: Append-only. Who accessed which patient's data and why; references only, no medical content.
audit.empty: No AI calls yet. Run an intake chat to see them here.
daily.title: Daily check-in
daily.notEnabled: Your doctor hasn't set up daily check-ins for you. If you'd like them, ask at your next visit.
daily.doneNote: You can update it until midnight. See you tomorrow.
daily.notePh: Optional, e.g. coffee late in the afternoon, a deadline, a missed dose
daily.yourWeeksNote: Since {date}. Your doctor sees the same picture.
trend.aria: Daily trends from {from} to {to}. A table view follows.
brief.consistencyNote: Where sources differ (chat answers, daily check-ins, wearable, records). Computed by code, not AI. A prompt for the conversation, not a judgement.
empty.trendsNote: Daily check-ins and wearable data are available before the pre-visit chat.
drawer.verifiedRegistry: Citation verified: this entry exists in the registry snapshot the clinic uses (simulated for the demo).
